title: Friend's family sees the same beach lights

tellings.quote:
which I thought was super cool cuz he
was out at the beach with his family and
they saw it late at night.

plain: Around 2020 or 2021, a friend of a NASA engineer named Charles Buhler was out at the beach near Cocoa Beach, Florida, late one night with his family, and they saw the same strange lights Buhler had seen. Buhler passes on his friend's account and says he "thought was super cool" that someone else had seen them. To him, it backed up his own sighting.
